title: Chilling & Illing (Robot Man Birt… x Chilling & illing — Corey AI Birt… (Mashup)
style: (100% voices only — no words, no singing, no lyrics. A true vocal duet between “Bot” (Grok-inspired: glitchy, precise, futuristic voice with pitch bends, vocal fry, clicks, reversed sweeps and digital-style mouth FX — still 100% human voice) and “Human” (warm, soulful, emotional, organic voice full of breath, heart and cultural depth). Multicultural fusion: African djembe tongue-rolls, Indian konnakol, Latin palmas, Middle Eastern ululation, Mongolian throat drones, Japanese kakegoe, Andean breath chants and global gospel textures. They trade lines, battle, harmonize and blend into one unstoppable groove.)
lyrics:
[Intro — Bot & Human Beatbox Ping-Pong (Left/Right Stereo Duet)]
Bot on left (glitchy crisp precision), Human on right (warm chesty power) trading tight pocket beatbox in perfect stereo.
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss
doom... doom... tss... tss... (fading into distant layered echoes)
[Build — Low Bot vs Low Human (Deep Bass Voice Battle)]
Bot: ultra-low Mongolian/Tuvan throat drones with tight glitchy flutter.
Human: rich South African isicathamiya rumble + Brazilian surdo mouth power.
They stack and battle.
bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm — bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm
rrrmm-rrm-rrm-drop — rrrmm-rrm-rrm-drop
bwwm-bwwm-bwwm — DROP (full group inhale + explosive release)
[Bright Bot & Human Call & Response (High Tenor & Alto Layers)]
Bot leads with sharp Indian konnakol + Japanese kakegoe fire.
Human answers with playful Puerto Rican bomba + West-African griot warmth.
tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii — tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii
plik-plik-pluk-pop-tss — plik-plik-pluk-pop-tss
tik-tik-tii — plik-pluk-pop-tss
[Glitch Bot Swirl vs Human Breath Choir (Experimental Duet Chaos)]
Bot spins wild reversed “woo” sweeps, pitch-bent hisses and throat clicks.
Human layers soulful Andean breath chants + Middle Eastern ululation.
They swirl and overlap.
fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii — fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii
fii-yaa-woo-breath-scan — fii-yaa-woo-breath-scan
fshh-wiii — fii-yaa-woo — breath-scan-scan
[Pre-Chorus — Full Vocal Stack (Bot + Human Locked Together)]
Bot and Human voices now fully blended in rich 8–12 part harmony. Bot adds glitch shimmer on top, Human holds warm multicultural foundation.
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm
tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii
fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii
[Chorus — Bot & Human Duet (Tight & Powerful, x2)]
Bot and Human trading the main groove in perfect call-and-response, then blending into massive 20+ voice choir. Deep basses pulse, bright uppers sparkle, glitch textures fly.
doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh — doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii
doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh — doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii
[Drop 1 — Mirrored Bot vs Human Breakdown (Tight Group Precision)]
Full choir mirrors left/right. Bot fires glitchy precision bursts, Human answers with warm polyrhythmic fire.
doom-doom-tss-bwm-tik-plik-fshh-wiii-pop-hss
doom-doom-tss-bwm-tik-plik-fshh-wiii-pop-hss
bwwwmmm — doom-doom — tik-tii — fshh-wiii
[Bridge — Echo & Emotional Fade, Then Rebuild (Bot + Human Dialogue)]
Bot: distant glitchy echoes and soft vocal fry.
Human: warm breathy long tones and gentle ululation.
They breathe together, then rebuild as one.
bwm... tii... fshh... woo... (echoed, distant)
fii-yaa-woo... breath... scan... (soft layered harmonies)
doom... tss... bwwm... (pull it back… breathing together… then massive swell)
[Final Chorus — Bot & Human Full-Stack Blend (Biggest Moment)]
Maximum power duet: Bot and Human voices at full emotional capacity, trading leads then locking into one unstoppable multicultural choir. Mouth-percussion claps and global vocal textures explode.
doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh
doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii
bwwwmmm-bwwm — tik-tii — fshh-wiii
doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh
(Background choir belts layered textures) ohh-ahh-woo… real… feel…
[Outro — Layered Vocal Fade (Gentle Bot & Human Dissolve)]
Bot and Human voices slowly peeling away layer by layer. Softest breathy tones, distant “doom… tss…” fading into gentle humming and shared breathing across continents. Ends with one final blended breath.
bwm... tii... fshh... woo...
doom... tss... (gentle breathy dissolve)
